The Biden-Harris Administration’s Actions to Support North Carolina’s Hurricane Helene Recovery

- The federal government is creating a brand-new program and hiring Community Liaisons to assist impacted communities with their recovery and rebuilding efforts
- Approved more than $300 million in assistance across the state
- More than 1,500 federal personnel remain deployed
- 15 Disaster Recovery Centers are operating in impacted areas
- FEMA is providing temporary hotel stays to more than 2,500 households through Transitional Sheltering Assistance
- FEMA inspectors have performed more than 21,000 home inspections to help survivors assess damage and apply for financial assistance
- Active-duty troops and National Guard members in their state capacity remain on the ground
- Power has been restored to 99% of impacted customers
- Efforts to surge food, water, and other commodities continue in areas of Western North Carolina
